Measure Population: All atoms belonging to the eligible molecules are counted in the denominator.
Measure Numerator: Atoms with XCL_003 = 'cl' are counted in the numerator.
Grain: The semijoin ensures each atom is counted once, regardless of the number of triple bonds in its molecule.
Units: The result is a percentage (0-100).

base_solution_anchor.base_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a."XCL_003" = 'cl' THEN a."XCL_001" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a."XCL_001") FROM atom AS a INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010" INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m."XCL_010" = b."XCL_005" WHERE m."XCL_011" = '-' AND b."XCL_006" = '#'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond b
      JOIN connected c ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
      WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
        AND b.XCL_006 = 'triple'
  )

react.raw_react_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a."XCL_003" = 'cl' THEN a."XCL_001" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a."XCL_001") FROM atom AS a INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010" WHERE m."XCL_011" = '-' AND m."XCL_010" IN (SELECT b."XCL_005" FROM bond AS b WHERE b."XCL_006" = '#')
